steps.en: Court case, mention and warrant details are displayed
steps.id: Detail court case, mention, dan warrant ditampilkan
steps.why_en: No working court detail view exists; the one UI leftover is off in the live environment.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tampilan detail court yang jalan; sisa UI-nya mati di lingkungan live.

steps.why_en: Defendant fields exist only as a data type; no screen shows them.
steps.why_id: Field defendant hanya ada sebagai tipe data; tidak ada layar yang menampilkannya.

steps.en: Officer is asked to pick a document type
steps.why_en: There is no document type choice anywhere in the portal.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pilihan jenis dokumen di mana pun di portal.

steps.why_en: No court document upload screen or receiver exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau penerima upload dokumen court.

steps.why_en: There is no upload page, so there is nothing to confirm.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada halaman upload, jadi tidak ada yang dikonfirmasi.
